Performance Report of Timing Conformance Test
=============================================
> * **Note:** Timing conformance test for the below mentioned standards are performed for the 2 x 10G design only. For any questions related to conformance test report, Renesas software and driver package contact [Renesas](https://www.renesas.com/contact/)

ITU-T G.8273.2 Full Time Support Standard
-----------------------------------------

AMD, in collaboration with Renesas, tested the TRD package for the ITU-T G.8273.2 Full Time Support Standard. 

ITU-T G.8273.4 Partial Time Support Standard
--------------------------------------------

AMD, in collaboration with Renesas, tested the TRD package for the ITU-T G.8273.4 Partial Time Support standard. 

### Test Reports
The performance report can be downloaded from [Compliance Test Report](https://www.renesas.com/en/products/clocks-timing/timing-partner-ecosystem/amd-5g-radio-evaluation-kit)

### Reference

* 8A3400x ITU-T G.8262 and G.8262.1 [8A3400X Compliance](https://www.renesas.com/en/document/rep/8a3400x-itu-t-g8262-and-g82621-compliance-test-report?r=455866)
